title: Scribbled Heads
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 21 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Heads in a few lines, then heads in a storm of them. This room begins in November 2022 with faces drawn in loose colored line on bright grounds, yellow, orange, magenta, green, and ends in March 2023 with the collection piece. Between them the winter heads arrive: dark, scribbled, with teeth bared.

The line heads are quick. A black loop for the skull, a few colored strokes for the features, the ground doing the rest. The scribbled heads are the opposite: hundreds of strokes piled on a dark face until only the eyes and the teeth show through.
Watch the ground go dark. It is yellow on November 16. By January it is black, and by February the faces have no ground at all, only scribble.

chapters.title: Heads in a Few Lines
chapters.opening: November 16 and 17, 2022. Four heads in loose line on bright grounds, each drawn in under a day of the last.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #42
works.text: A head on yellow drawn in black line, with a red box around the face, one small eye at the left and one white ring at the right, and a grin of white teeth. Grey scribble fills the ground behind it, and a few blue lines run through the face. Sixty-two strokes. The head is a box inside a box, the way the masks were, but drawn in air: nothing is filled, and the yellow comes through everywhere.
works.caption: A head on yellow drawn in black line, a red box around the face, one white ring eye, a grin of white teeth.
works.reading: The outer line of the head runs down from the top edge and around the jaw, with a second line inside it. The red box frames the eyes and the nose. The teeth are a small row of white blocks. The grey marks on the yellow are loose and wide.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #43
works.text: A head in profile on orange, drawn in black line with a blue X for an eye, a grin of white and black teeth, and an ear drawn as a spiral.
works.caption: A head in profile on orange in black line, a blue X for an eye, a grin of white and black teeth.
works.reading: The X is drawn in blue over a black ring at the left. The teeth are a row of white and black blocks in a pink mouth. The ear at the right is a loop of black and blue. Fifty-one strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #44
works.text: A head on magenta in black and colored line, two ringed eyes, a crest of black scribble for hair, and a mouth of white teeth in a red box.
works.caption: A head on magenta in black and colored line, two ringed eyes, black scribble for hair, white teeth in red.
works.reading: The hair is a band of black loops along the top. The eyes are rings with yellow and blue inside. The teeth are white blocks in a red box. Recorded with 127 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #45
works.text: A head in profile on green, drawn in a single pink and yellow line, with a red eye and a mouth of white teeth at the right.
works.caption: A head in profile on green in a single pink and yellow line, a red eye, white teeth at the right.
works.reading: The line runs around the whole head without lifting, in pink with yellow beside it. The eye is a red knot with a yellow ring. The teeth are white blocks in a red mouth. Forty-six strokes.

chapters.title: The Scribble Arrives
chapters.opening: November 22 and 23, 2022. Three heads where the scribble comes in: a purple head with yellow hair, an orange cat head, and a head lit by a beam.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #46
works.text: A purple head with a crest of yellow strokes for hair, two ringed eyes, and a wide grin of white teeth, in colored scribble on purple.
works.caption: A purple head with a crest of yellow strokes for hair, two ringed eyes and a wide grin of white teeth.
works.reading: The hair is yellow and green strokes standing up along the top. The eyes are rings with red inside. The teeth are two rows of white blocks in a red mouth. Recorded with 108 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #47
works.text: A cat head on orange, drawn in thick black loops over teal and yellow paint, with two eyes, one a spiral and one a white ring, and a small grin. The ears are two black points. A black shadow spreads under the head like spilled ink. The scribble here is black and heavy, and it covers the face so that the features are found inside it. It is the first of the dark heads.
works.caption: A cat head on orange in thick black loops over teal and yellow, a spiral eye and a ringed eye, a small grin.
works.reading: The loops are thick and round, drawn many times over, so the head is a ball of black. The spiral eye at the left is black over yellow; the ringed eye at the right is white with a dark pupil. The shadow is a black blot below. Eighty-two strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #48
works.text: A head on purple with spiky hair, two boxed eyes, and a yellow beam pouring from its mouth to the right, drawn in colored scribble over dark paint.
works.caption: A head on purple with spiky hair and boxed eyes, a yellow beam pouring from its mouth to the right.
works.reading: The beam is a broad soft wedge of yellow from the mouth to the edge. The eyes are two boxes with yellow inside. A small figure with raised arms stands at the lower left. Recorded with 159 strokes.

chapters.title: Winter Heads
chapters.opening: January 18 to February 15, 2023. Eight dark heads in scribble, with teeth bared, and one yellow figure with bones.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #49
works.text: A dark head with two mouths of white teeth, one above the other, a red propeller for one eye and a yellow ring for the other, drawn in white, blue and red line over black. A black flower hangs at the upper right. The head is outlined in heavy white, and the two mouths fill the lower half. It is the first of the winter heads, drawn January 18, 2023, and the first with the teeth doubled.
works.caption: A dark head with two mouths of white teeth, one above the other, a red propeller eye and a yellow ring eye.
works.reading: The upper mouth is a wide row of white teeth in a red frame; the lower is a second row below. The propeller eye is red blades in a ring. The flower at the upper right is black petals on a yellow stem. Recorded with 186 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #50
works.text: A dark head in yellow, blue and black scribble with a blue X over one eye, a box of teeth where the other should be, and a grin of yellow teeth below.
works.caption: A dark head in yellow and blue scribble, a blue X over one eye, a box of teeth for the other, a yellow grin.
works.reading: The X is drawn in blue over a dark ring at the right. The left eye is a white box with a grid of teeth inside. The grin is yellow blocks in a dark mouth. Recorded with 263 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #53
works.text: A dark round head in scribble with one eye a red ring and the other a red oval, a grin of white teeth, and a white line running down the brow.
works.caption: A dark round head in scribble, one eye a red ring, the other a red oval, a grin of white teeth.
works.reading: The white line runs from the top of the head to the nose like a crack. The ring eye at the right is drawn in red and white with spikes around it. The grin is white blocks in a red mouth. Recorded with 328 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #54
works.text: A tall dark head on brown, two hollow eyes with spiky lids, each with a small ring inside, a long dark nose, and a wide mouth of white teeth in red. The head is drawn in grey and brown scribble with a heavy black edge. Two months after the head on yellow in sixty-two strokes, this is the same head drawn in darkness: a box of a face, two eyes, a grin, with the ground gone black.
works.caption: A tall dark head on brown, two hollow eyes with spiky lids, a long nose, a wide mouth of white teeth.
works.reading: The eyes are two dark sockets with small white rings inside and spikes above them. The nose is a long dark shape with a white edge. The teeth are white blocks in a red mouth that spans the face. Recorded with 192 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #55
works.text: A dark head in scribble with a ringed eye and a spiral eye, a mouth open on white teeth and a red tongue, on a ground of colored bars.
works.caption: A dark head in scribble with a ringed eye and a spiral eye, a mouth open on white teeth and a red tongue.
works.reading: The tongue hangs below the teeth as a red shape. The eyes are drawn in white and yellow rings over dark. The bars behind are teal, red and yellow. Recorded with 244 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #56
works.caption: A dark cat head in purple, blue and black scribble, two round eyes, a grille of white teeth below.
works.reading: The ears are two black points. The eyes are rings in white with dark centers. The teeth are white bars in a red mouth. The ground is dark teal. Recorded with 173 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #57
works.text: A yellow figure in a frame with white bones sticking out of its head and shoulders, one arm raised, drawn in yellow and black line over a grey square.
works.caption: A yellow figure in a frame with white bones sticking out of its head and shoulders, one arm raised.
works.reading: The bones are white shapes drawn at the shoulders and the top of the head like pins. The figure is yellow scribble with a white edge. The frame is lilac around a dark grey square. Recorded with 121 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #58
works.text: A dense mask with two green hearts above the eyes, a ringed eye and a crossed eye, a grille of white teeth, on brown.
works.caption: A dense mask with two green hearts above the eyes, a ringed eye and a crossed eye, white teeth.
works.reading: The hearts are green with white edges. The ringed eye at the left has white rays; the crossed eye at the right is a red X in a ring. The teeth are white blocks in a red box. Recorded with 182 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #59
works.caption: A blue mask on a blue body with a crossed ringed eye, a mouth of white and black teeth, a small figure at the lower left.
works.reading: The eye is a white ring with a red X across it. The teeth are a long bar of white blocks with black between. The small figure at the lower left is drawn in black with a pointed hat. Recorded with 144 strokes.

chapters.title: March 14 and 15
chapters.opening: The last night. Four works between March 14 and 15, 2023, and then the collection piece, drawn last.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #60
works.text: Three figures in a frame, a skull, a white skeleton and a pink robot, drawn in colored line over a crowded ground, with a small black figure at the lower right.
works.caption: Three figures in a frame: a skull, a white skeleton and a pink robot, a small black figure below.
works.reading: The skull at the left is drawn in black and yellow with a red target on its chest. The skeleton at the center is white line with a round head. The robot at the right is pink with a blue head. Recorded with 276 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #61
works.text: A mask with a bird's head for one eye, its beak open on white teeth, a red ringed eye beside it, and a beam of red crossing from the upper right, on blue.
works.caption: A mask with a bird's head for one eye, its beak open on white teeth, a red ringed eye, a red beam.
works.reading: The bird's head is yellow with a spiral eye and a row of fangs in its beak. The ringed eye is pink and red. The beam is a red bar with white zigzag. Recorded with 106 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #62
works.text: A figure with a sun for a head runs across red, in a blue shirt, one arm raised, drawn in red and white line over soft teal discs.
works.caption: A figure with a sun for a head runs across red in a blue shirt, one arm raised.
works.reading: The sun head is a ring of red and yellow rays around a face with white teeth. The shirt is blue with white line. The legs are drawn in red and white with black shoes. Ninety-two strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #63
works.text: A round mask split in two, half yellow and half brown, with a ringed eye on each side, a red target for a mouth, in a frame of grey, drawn March 15, 2023.
works.caption: A round mask split in two, half yellow and half brown, a ringed eye on each side, a red target mouth.
works.reading: The yellow half has a ringed eye with yellow rays; the brown half has a ringed eye with a blue spiral. The mouth is a red target with white teeth beside it. Blue capsules sit at the upper right. Recorded with 122 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #0000
works.text: The collection piece, an edition of one, drawn last on March 15, 2023. A crowd of figures from the series in one square: a black crow at the top, a skull head on a striped body, a yellow sun-face with a grin, a black cat with X eyes, a blue skull in a ring, a small masked head. Every mark of the series is here, the beams, the X, the crown, the teeth. Where the first work of May 2022 packed a single mask to the frame, this one packs the whole series.
works.caption: A crowd of figures from the series in one square: a crow, a skull head, a sun-face, a black cat with X eyes.
works.reading: The crow at the upper left is a black shape with a red X. The skull head at the top center has a crown of white spikes and a grin of white teeth. The black cat at the lower left has two yellow X marks. The sun-face at the center right is a round head with an angry grin. Recorded with 362 strokes.

closing: Look again at the head on yellow from November, sixty-two strokes of black line with the ground showing through, and then at the collection piece, where the square is full. The room went from one line to a crowd in four months.
